horizontal_model.method: closed Catmull-Rom spline through public station coordinates
horizontal_model.station_anchor_source: public station coordinate table; exact OSM physical track geometry not fetched in this runtime
horizontal_model.rule: This is a preview/fallback only. Replace with independent physical railway=subway centerlines extracted from child route relations 300607 (Inner) and 1462011 (Outer), or stronger project alignment.
horizontal_model.curvature_sample_note: Radius estimated from neighboring 25 m plan samples; diagnostic only.

vertical_model.station_depth_semantics: published depth below local surface; datum is not reliably UGR for every source
vertical_model.rule: Do not interpolate published depths as absolute tunnel Z. First sample a DEM/survey in a known vertical datum, then convert only depths with known datum and solve the constrained vertical profile.

expected_upgrade_path: fetch current OSM child route 300607 (Inner) relation/full or equivalent PBF objects
fetch current OSM child route 1462011 (Outer) relation/full or equivalent PBF objects
preserve physical way/node graph separately for each route; do not build one track as an offset of the other
resolve branch/crossover edges with explicit topology annotations
sample FABDEM/Copernicus or project LandXML surface
export separate alignment_3d data for both physical main tracks to Blender
warnings: Station coordinates are not guaranteed to be platform-axis or tunnel-axis survey coordinates.
Spline is not an as-built track centerline.
Published station depth is retained as an anchor attribute only, not used as z_ugr.
Current OSM underground geometry may itself be approximate.
OSM route hierarchy is resolved, but child-relation way/node bytes have not been acquired in this research runtime; no way IDs are guessed.
